title: feat(qa): skill-evals --case runs the named eval cases alone; any-of prose in the cli header and README

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DLCo5F2y7fgbM8tstGoyyUn)_

Fixes #37980

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化:跑技能评测的人现在可以用一个新选项只跑指定的几道题,两组对照照常跑;平台用户无感。
- 为什么做:技能评测验收的后续收尾,以前单题验收只能靠一段没提交的临时脚本,审核看不到驱动代码。
- 出错会怎样:只影响在仓库里手动跑评测的人,最坏是选题报错或计划不对;可以直接撤回,不碰任何技能文字和题目。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

**Flag spelling: `--case KEY[,KEY…]`**, where KEY is the case key the summary and every run record already print, `BUNDLE/FILE_STEM#ID` (e.g. `objectstack-ai/skills-tools-knowledge#6`). Not `BUNDLE:ID`: ids repeat across a bundle's eval files in 10 of the 14 bundles on `main` (`objectstack-data` has three files each starting at id 1), so a bundle plus an id does not name one case. The flag repeats and de-duplicates; the plan keeps catalog order.

- **Plan**: only the named cases, through the unchanged `planRound`, so a behaviour case runs on both arms and a trigger case on the with-skill arm only.
- **Refusals, located** (`selectCases` in `cases.ts`): an unknown bundle names the catalog's bundles; a known bundle with no such eval file names the bundle's eval files; a known file with no such id names that file's ids; a malformed key is refused at parse time. Refused beside `--regrade` and `--self-test` (same shape as `--triggers-only`'s refusals).
- **With `--skills`**: every named case must belong to a `--skills` bundle (otherwise refused, naming the `--skills` list); `--skills` keeps its other job, the competing set a trigger turn installs. Without `--skills`, a trigger turn installs every bundle, as in a whole round, so a single-case trigger round measures the same conditions the full round does.
- **With `--triggers-only`**: refused. The keys already say which cases run, and a named trigger case already runs on the with-skill arm alone.
- **`round.json`** (additive only): `scope.selectedCases: string[]` (the keys, catalog order), present only on a `--case` round. `scope.arms` on a `--case` round lists the arms its jobs actually use (with-skill alone when every named case is a trigger case); `skills.allBundles` is `false` on a `--case` round. The summary title names the cases and a header line lists the keys. `--regrade DIR` keeps the scope through a new pure `roundCatalogCases` (which also carries the existing `--triggers-only` narrowing), so the rest of a bundle is not reported as "added since the round".
- **Prose (N4)**: the `cli.ts` header names `must_contain` / `must_contain_any` / `must_not_contain` and documents `--case`; the README gets a `--case` bullet and example; the README's unmet-group form now reads ``(none of: `a` / `b`)``, each token in a code span, as `summary.ts` renders it (the same spelling fix in that file's code comment).

No eval file and no skill text changes. One changeset, `@objectstack/scenarios` patch.

## Tests

<details><summary>skill-evals --self-test on c6ffc0b813: 44 rows pass (four new rows, roster floor 40 → 44)</summary>

New rows:
- `select: --case plans exactly the named cases, a behaviour case on both arms and a trigger case on the with-skill arm`
- `select: --case naming an unknown bundle, eval file or id, or a bundle --skills leaves out → REFUSED with its location`
- `flags: --case beside --regrade, --self-test or --triggers-only, or a key not shaped BUNDLE/FILE_STEM#ID → REFUSED`
- `regrade: a --case round regrades at its named cases; the rest of their bundles are not "added since"`

## Acceptance notes

- The unreleased changeset from the any-of PR (`.changeset/37928-skill-evals-any-of.md`) still says the summary prints `(none of: a / b)`. It is outside this card's file surface (one new changeset), so it is left as is; it compiles into the scenarios CHANGELOG at the next release.

## Verification

Read first (by risk): `packages/qa/scenarios/src/skill-evals/cli.ts` (the `main()` hunk where `selectCases` narrows `selectBundles`' answer, and the `scope` construction), `packages/qa/scenarios/src/skill-evals/cases.ts` (`selectCases`), `packages/qa/scenarios/src/skill-evals/self-test.ts` (the four new rows).

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios skill-evals --dry-run --case objectstack-ai/skills-tools-knowledge#6 --repeats 10`. Expect one bundle line, `1 behaviour case(s) × 2 arms, × 10 = 20 turn(s)`, and the `--case` line naming that one key.
